title: Separable blur bench
label: Blur bench: a pin block of 13 by 13 Gaussian-height pins with a 49 × 49 readout and a dial, beside a framed dot-grid tray crossed by a column comb and a row comb, each with 13 Gaussian pins.
caption: One blur dial, two ways to spend it: the pin block reads a whole 49 × 49 square, 2,401 taps per pixel; the two combs read a row and then a column, 49 + 49 = 98 taps. Move across the bench to change the blur: the pins re-flow to a narrower Gaussian and the combs park at the tray's back edges.
